_comment:
'When this defends, **freeze** the attacking hero until the start of their next turn.' + printed **Blade Break**. Ice Equipment - Head.

TRIGGER: release note 1 settles WHEN this is checked - it triggers when Crown becomes a defending card - so an event TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND, not a static. play.py emits one 'defend' event per defending card at declaration (play.py:1374-1376, carrying the card), and _dsl_defend_listener dispatches ON_DEFEND to that defending card itself (engine.py:1640-1646), so no source-scoping condition is needed: the ability only ever hears Crown's own defends.

EFFECT: FREEZE reads either a ref or the canonical object-target dict (effect_types.py:3149-3178); the dict keys are controller/zone(s)/name/ref/record_as/amount/filter (effect_types.py:635-709). {"controller": "OPPONENT", "zone": "HERO"} resolves through _object_zone_cards' HERO branch -> [player.hero] (effect_types.py:485-486). From Crown's perspective OPPONENT is the attacking player, so this is 'the attacking hero' - and release note 2 (defending against an ALLY makes the ally's controller the attacking hero) freezes the same object either way, because the target derives from Crown's controller's opponent rather than from what attacked.

DURATION: the DSL FREEZE effect exposes no duration parameter; the freeze primitive's default (effect_keywords.py:2513-2526) unfreezes at START_OF_TURN of the FROZEN CARD'S controller - i.e. the start of the attacking hero's next turn, exactly the printed duration. Note this is NOT the CR 8.5.34b no-duration default (which would be the FREEZER'S next turn); the engine primitive keys on the victim's controller, which happens to be what this card prints. No duration had to be expressed.

PRINTED KEYWORDS NOT AUTHORED: Blade Break is engine-side from the DB keywords field (ability_keywords.blade_break). 'Freeze' in printed_keywords is inert as a DB tag (same reading as .drafts/cold_snap_yellow.json); the actual freezing is the effect above, so the SOURCE_IS_ATTACK conditional-keyword shape does not apply.

ENGINE CAVEAT FOR REVIEW: __frozen__ gates playing/activating cards (play.py:370-384 _legality_check). A HERO is never played or activated, so unless/until the engine models whatever a frozen hero concretely does, freezing the hero here is bookkeeping plus the FreezeEvent - the JSON is right, but a behavioural test should assert on the counter/event, not on a gameplay difference.
